detail.command: mkdir -p /tmp/mrg && for f in index.ts ui.css; do for s in 1 2 3; do git show :$s:src/ui/$f > /tmp/mrg/$f.$s; done; done; wc -c /tmp/mrg/*; echo '=== DIFF base->ours index.ts (word-diff) ==='; git diff --no-index --word-diff=plain --unified=0 /tmp/mrg/index.ts.1 /tmp/mrg/index.ts.2 | head -c 12000
